Financial/contact receipts remain under `outputs/d5/stage-b-v5-20261107/`; no credential or opaque thinking signature is included here.

The corrected response generated by `corrected()` in `test_workspace_d5_prose_repair.py` is explicitly synthetic. It preserves “perhaps” in c5, removes the stronger CoT-SC attribution, moves scientific statements into scored claim references, and makes the remaining questions procedural. It earns no credit as a successful live response, independent semantic review, or human label.
